label: Late-episode D1 after an unrewarded rare a2 trial (a2 -> S1, no reward), agent about to repeat a2
explanation: Fires only at D1 (none at GO or D2), almost only when the reward input is 0 and the previous trial was a2 with a rare transition to S1 (prev_common==1 gives zero activations; prev_common==-1 is just the window first trial, where the history is unknown). It is also tightly gated by episode position: nothing before trial ~50, and 81% of the mass falls in trials 90-99. The agent then repeats a2 (the model-based response to rare-unrewarded; action==2 holds for 100% of activations). This is the agent own upcoming choice, which is allowed, so no unobservable variable is used. It co-occurs with low model value (<5.2) and a strong a2 policy logit. Magnitude is larger at trials >=95 and on D1 fixation-break steps (d1_err, 26% active rate, high mass). It does not fire after rewarded trials, after common transitions, after a1, or early in the episode. Precision is limited (~0.7 on dev): many late rare-unrewarded a2 D1 steps stay silent, so the episode-time gate is soft. Dev F1 0.77, mass recall 0.87; the ep_trial>=85 version gets mass recall 0.94 with F1 0.72.
